gaps: Initial API requires case ID and exact canonical query; replaces raw rider query before retrieval.
UI calls missing rider API endpoints, accepts JSON only, hides free chat input after first message.
Static UI bearer authentication lacks refreshable Cloud Run identity and verified visitor ownership.
selection_requirements: Accept bounded arbitrary raw query without client topic/case selection; reserve operation and admission before real BGE/BM25 query embedding.
Expose bounded candidate ranking separately from dependency assembly; map immutable hit evidence to exact approved registry records.
Version independently reviewed per-record subject aliases, allowed operations, quantities/units/comparators and qualifiers from exact source claim scopes.
Require matching subject, supported requested operation, coverage of every substantive clause, no incompatible negation/quantity/variant and bounded candidate separation.
Topical repair/bypass/modification/root-cause asks must not receive unrelated lookup facts. Reranker relevance is ordering only, never source sufficiency or request-scope authority.
Mixed intents require coverage or focused ambiguity/abstention; same-scope compound facts may remain one request.

Selected singleton controller retains TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN eligibility, verified dependencies/warnings and exact canonical wording. No all-registry tags, canonical query substitution, fixture facts or provider fallback.
Do not infer confirmed observations from arbitrary text; unknown prerequisites remain unknown. No mandatory diagnostic wizard or topic selection introduced.
Conservative lexical scope policy accepts arbitrary input but sacrifices coverage; evaluate heldout paraphrases, negation and topical unsupported requests before claiming quality.
ownership_stream_requirements: Keep private Cloud Run IAM, refresh audience-bound identity tokens server-side and separately verify high-entropy signed visitor capability.
Bind session/operation/admission to verified visitor plus trusted UI principal; cross-visitor reads fail like missing records, new chat preserves visitor limits.
Fixed24h sessions and dedicated immutable versions; exact payload hash and operation replay;202 running recovery must never rerun mutation.
Render bounded complete verified SSE block only after durable state and operation commit; verify matching final view and avoid duplicate replay transcript.
Handle disconnect through bounded authenticated recovery, reject redirects/oversized or inconsistent events, and keep normal chat input available after each completed response.
Public anonymous reset abuse needs trusted edge/challenge controls; no raw query/token/capability/media in routine logs.
required_evidence: Fresh-browser arbitrary paraphrases traverse real retrieval with no client case IDs.
Unsupported topical repairs, bypasses, mixed intent, wrong scope and injection fail closed; source mutation and retrieval/storage failure remain distinct.
Two visitors cannot recover each other's sessions/operations; replay and interrupted SSE create no duplicate retrieval.
Exact new runtime/source review and hosted regression closure precede rollout; static initial30 acceptance does not establish open-query accuracy or p95.
